items.title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said Tuesday he would be prepared to support an interest rate hike if inflation doesn't ease.

items.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
items.summary: BEIJING — A popular new programmable personal robot from a French-American company is powered by a chip from Shanghai-listed Rockchip which in turn uses British company ARM's tech, reflecting how intertwined global tech supply chains remain.

items.title: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
items.summary: Just a few carefully chosen words from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh convinced markets that he was serious about inflation and ready to recommend an interest rate hike in just a few weeks.

items.title: Kalshi partners with brokerage Alpaca as it tries to build its international audience
items.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi is working with brokerage and financial infrastructure startup Alpaca to bring its event contracts to an international audience, subject to local regulatory approval.

items.title: Crypto exchange Gemini not at fault for collapse of Earn lending program, arbitrator says
items.summary: Gemini Space Station scored a legal victory earlier in August after an arbitrator found the crypto exchange did not mislead users and was not at fault for the collapse of its Earn lending program.

items.title: Aon CEO says insurance broker seeks to build 'premiere middle market platform' with purchase of rival USI
items.summary: Insurance broker Aon announced on Monday it will purchase rival USI Insurance Services from private equity firm KKR .

items.title: Jackson Hole analyst roundup: Warsh's speech sends hike chances higher, may put Fed 'at odds' with Treasury
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's stance in his speech at the Jackson Hole meeting was unexpectedly hawkish , boosting market expectations for a rate hike next month.

items.title: Euro zone inflation is back above 3%. Higher interest rates are likely to follow
items.summary: Energy price pressures drove inflation in the euro zone back above 3% in August, with hard-hit businesses now likely facing a second blow from higher interest rates.

items.title: There’s a disconnect between AI valuations and revenue-growth forecasts, observes this investor
Are rising bond rates really so bad? Maybe not, say these experts.
